text:
People Ops: Quick heads-up — were instituting a company-wide Global Wellness Day on Sept 24 (one paid day off for everyone) and a new policy for "blackout" windows around major releases. Full policy + FAQ: https://intranet.redwood.ai/policies/global-wellness-day :sun_with_face:

Maya (HR Lead): Global Wellness Day is paid and automatic; you dont need to submit PTO. Please treat it as a company holiday — no meetings scheduled unless previously exempted. Well post calendar blocks for everyone.

Samir (Manager): How do we handle teams with critical customer commitments (oncall, incident response)?

People Ops: Good question — exemptions available via the "critical coverage" flow. Managers must submit coverage plans by Aug 31. Exempted teammates will be offered a compensatory flex day within 30 days. Oncall recovery days remain unchanged.

Raj (Security): Note: security ops will need a minimal skeleton crew for SOC duties. Well coordinate with Security leadership for who stays on rotation. Those approved as critical will get a `wellness.exempt` flag.

Maya (HR Lead): Code of conduct reminder: while this is a wellness day, any company-hosted events (virtual or in-person) are still covered by our COC and harassment policy. Please review the quick guidance in the FAQ before hosting team gatherings.

devops-bot: Reminder: If your repo has a release scheduled within the blackout window (Sept 23Sept 25), annotate the PR with `release-exempt` and update the release calendar. Automated deploys are allowed only for emergency patches.

People Ops: Were also piloting a "no-meeting" window from 09:0017:00 local on Wellness Day for participating teams. Meetings for existing customer SLAs are exempt, but please keep them short. Calendar overlays and an RSVP toggle will appear in the calendar UI.

Samir (Manager): Will there be a payroll/timesheet impact for exempt employees who work that day?

Maya (HR Lead): Exempt employees approved to work will receive a compensation flex-day instead; payroll tags: `wellness.paid` for auto days and `wellness.exempt` for those approved to work. Payroll note: log the compensatory day in the usual PTO form with code `comp.wellness`.

People Ops: Rollout timeline: policy published now; calendar blocks next week; manager coverage submissions due Aug 31; Wellness Day Sept 24. Town hall next Tue 10:00 PT for managers to walk through the exemption flow. DM People Ops for edge cases or urgent questions.
